source.text: הִנְנִ֤י שֹׁלֵחַ֙ מַלְאָכִ֔י וּפִנָּה־דֶ֖רֶךְ לְפָנָ֑י וּפִתְאֹם֩ יָב֨וֹא אֶל־הֵיכָל֜וֹ הָאָד֣וֹן׀אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּ֣ם מְבַקְשִׁ֗ים וּמַלְאַ֨ךְ הַבְּרִ֜ית אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּ֤ם חֲפֵצִים֙ הִנֵּה־בָ֔א אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, I [am] sending my messenger, and he will clear [the] way before me; and suddenly he will come to his temple, the Lord whom you are seeking, and the messenger of the covenant, in whom you delight; look, he is coming, says Yahweh of hosts.

en.L: Look, I am sending {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} messenger, \q and he will clear the way before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; \q and suddenly the Lord whom you are seeking will come to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple, and the messenger of the covenant, in whom you delight; look, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is coming, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts.
en.B: See, I am sending {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} messenger, \q and he will clear the way ahead of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q Then suddenly the Lord you are seeking will come to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple; the messenger of the covenant, whom you desire, is coming, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.
en.R: Look! I am sending {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} messenger \q to prepare the way for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q Then suddenly the Lord you are looking for will come to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple. The messenger of the covenant, the one you want to see, is coming, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

fr.L: Voici, j’envoie {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} messager, \q et il préparera le chemin devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ; \q et soudain viendra dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple le Seigneur que vous cherchez, et le messager de l’alliance, en qui vous prenez plaisir ; voici, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vient, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.B: Voici que j’envoie {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} messager, \q et il préparera le chemin devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. \q Alors soudain, le Seigneur que vous cherchez entrera dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple ; le messager de l’alliance, que vous désirez, va venir, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.R: Regardez ! J’envoie {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} messager \q pour préparer la route pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. \q Alors soudain, le Seigneur que vous cherchez viendra dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple. Le messager de l’alliance, celui que vous voulez voir, va venir, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.

es.L: He aquí, yo envío a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mensajero, \q y preparará el camino delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}; \q y vendrá de repente a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo el Señor a quien {{plural_you:ustedes buscan|vosotros buscáis}}, y el mensajero del pacto, en quien {{plural_you:se complacen|os complacéis}}; he aquí, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} viene, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos.
es.B: Yo envío a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mensajero, \q y él preparará el camino delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q Entonces vendrá de repente a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo el Señor a quien {{plural_you:ustedes buscan|vosotros buscáis}}; ya viene el mensajero del pacto, a quien {{plural_you:desean|deseáis}}, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.
es.R: ¡Atención! Voy a enviar a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mensajero \q para que prepare el camino delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q Entonces, de repente, el Señor a quien {{plural_you:ustedes buscan|vosotros buscáis}} vendrá a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo. Ya viene el mensajero del pacto, el que {{plural_you:ustedes desean|vosotros deseáis}} ver, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

decisions.choice: my messenger: one sent ahead to prepare for the LORD's coming
decisions.reason: "My messenger" (mal'akhi) is the same as the prophet's name (1:1). Here he is one the LORD will send to prepare the way before him, as a herald goes ahead of a king. 3:23 names him: "Elijah the prophet". |

decisions.choice: he will clear the way before me: the words of Isaiah 40:3
decisions.reason: The verb and noun are the same as in Isaiah 40:3, "In the wilderness clear the way of the LORD". The road is cleared for the LORD himself to come. |

decisions.choice: quoted in Mark 1:2 and Matthew 11:10
decisions.reason: Mark 1:2, joining this verse to Isaiah 40:3, and Jesus in Matthew 11:10 (also Luke 7:27) apply the promise to John the Baptist. Their Greek wording differs from the Hebrew: "I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way", so that "before me" becomes "before you". The verse here is translated from the Hebrew. |

decisions.choice: the Lord who comes to his temple, and the messenger of the covenant
alternatives: the messenger of the covenant as a second figure, distinct from the Lord
decisions.reason: "The Lord" (ha'adon) coming to "his temple" is God himself, who says in verse 5, "I will draw near to you for judgment". This answers the question of 2:17, "Where is the God of justice?" "The messenger of the covenant" is set in parallel with the Lord, and may be the same figure, God coming in person as the angel of the LORD came in Israel's early history (Exodus 23:20-23), or a messenger who enforces the covenant. The text does not settle it. Both titles are lowercase as descriptions. Christians have read the coming Lord as Jesus, coming to the temple after John prepared his way.

decisions.choice: whom you are seeking, in whom you delight: the God the people say they want
decisions.reason: The people asked for the God of justice (2:17). They will get what they asked for, but his coming will be a day of judgment for them too (verse 2). |

decisions.choice: my messenger, the messenger of the covenant, lowercase at every level; clear the way (L, B)
decisions.reason: Both messengers are lowercase at every level, as set for Malachi. "Clear the way" follows Isaiah 40:3 at Literal; Readable says "prepare the way". The pronouns "his temple" and "he is coming" refer to the coming Lord, and take the deity_pronoun setting; "he will clear the way" refers to the messenger and does not. |

decisions.choice: "j'envoie mon messager", lowercase, at every level; "il préparera le chemin devant moi" (L, B), "préparer la route pour moi" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet: the published Mark 1:2 and Matthew 11:10 share these words, and "préparer le chemin" is the verb of Isaiah 40:3, which Malachi echoes; "messager" stays lowercase, as "le messager de l'alliance".

decisions.choice: "preparará el camino" / "prepare el camino"
decisions.reason: The English says "clear the way" at L and B; Spanish keeps "preparar el camino", the words of Matthew 11:10, Mark 1:2 and Luke 7:27 in Spanish, because the Hebrew allows it and the quotation can then be seen. The Gospels' Greek adds "before your face", which the Hebrew does not have.

decisions.choice: "mi mensajero", "el mensajero del pacto", lowercase
decisions.reason: Both messengers are lowercase, as in the English; "mi" takes a deity_pronoun span as God's own word.

source.text: וּמִ֤י מְכַלְכֵּל֙ אֶת־י֣וֹם בּוֹא֔וֹ וּמִ֥י הָעֹמֵ֖ד בְּהֵרָֽאוֹת֑וֹ כִּֽי־הוּא֙ כְּאֵ֣שׁ מְצָרֵ֔ף וּכְבֹרִ֖ית מְכַבְּסִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And who can endure the day of his coming, and who [is] the one standing when he appears? For he [is] like a refiner's fire and like launderers' soap.

en.L: But who can endure the day of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} coming, \q and who is the one who stands when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appears? \q For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is] like the fire of a refiner \q and like the soap of launderers.
en.B: But who can bear the day of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} coming? \q Who can hold their ground when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appears? \q For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will be like a refiner's fire \q and like the soap of those who wash clothes.
en.R: But who will be able to live through the day when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} comes? \q Who will be able to stand when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appears? \q He will be like a fire that makes metal pure, \q like strong soap that makes clothes clean.

fr.L: Mais qui supportera le jour de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} venue, \q et qui [est] celui qui tiendra debout quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} paraîtra ? \q Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [est] comme le feu du fondeur \q et comme la soude des blanchisseurs.
fr.B: Mais qui pourra supporter le jour de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} venue ? \q Qui tiendra bon quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} paraîtra ? \q Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sera comme le feu du fondeur \q et comme le savon de ceux qui lavent le linge.
fr.R: Mais qui pourra survivre au jour où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} viendra ? \q Qui pourra rester debout quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} apparaîtra ? \q Il sera comme un feu qui rend le métal pur, \q comme un savon puissant qui rend les vêtements propres.

es.L: ¿Pero quién podrá soportar el día de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} venida, \q y quién [es] el que podrá mantenerse en pie cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} aparezca? \q Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] como fuego de fundidor \q y como jabón de lavanderos.
es.B: Pero ¿quién podrá soportar el día de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} venida? \q ¿Quién podrá mantenerse firme cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} aparezca? \q Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} será como fuego de fundidor \q y como el jabón de los que lavan la ropa.
es.R: Pero ¿quién podrá sobrevivir el día en que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} venga? \q ¿Quién podrá quedar en pie cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} aparezca? \q Él será como el fuego que purifica el metal, \q como un jabón fuerte que deja limpia la ropa.

decisions.choice: who can endure the day of his coming?: as in Joel 2:11
decisions.reason: Joel 2:11 asks of the day of the LORD, "who can endure it?" The people longed for God to come and judge (2:17), but none of them can face him unchanged. |

decisions.choice: a refiner's fire, launderers' soap: fire that melts out impurities, lye that bleaches cloth
decisions.reason: Silver and gold were melted in a furnace so that the dross could be skimmed off. Launderers, who cleaned and bleached new cloth, used a strong soap made from the ashes of plants (Jeremiah 2:22). Both pictures are of cleansing that is painful but makes pure. |

decisions.choice: a fire that makes metal pure (R), strong soap that makes clothes clean (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what refiners and launderers did. |

decisions.choice: "fuego de fundidor" (L, B); "el fuego que purifica el metal" (R)
decisions.reason: The refiner melts out impurities; R says what he does, as the English R does.

source.text: וְיָשַׁ֨ב מְצָרֵ֤ף וּמְטַהֵר֙ כֶּ֔סֶף וְטִהַ֤ר אֶת־בְּנֵֽי־לֵוִי֙ וְזִקַּ֣ק אֹתָ֔ם כַּזָּהָ֖ב וְכַכָּ֑סֶף וְהָיוּ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה מַגִּישֵׁ֥י מִנְחָ֖ה בִּצְדָקָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he will sit refining and purifying silver, and he will purify the sons of Levi and refine them like gold and like silver; and they will be to Yahweh presenting an offering in righteousness.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will sit refining and purifying silver, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will cleanse the sons of Levi and refine them \q like gold and like silver; \q and they will belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q presenting an offering in righteousness.
en.B: He will sit like one who refines and purifies silver; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will purify the descendants of Levi and refine them \q like gold and silver, \q so that they will belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q and bring offerings in righteousness.
en.R: He will sit like a worker who melts silver to make it pure. \q He will make the priests from the tribe of Levi pure, \q as gold and silver are made pure. \q Then they will bring offerings to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q in the right way.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} siégera, épurant et purifiant l’argent, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} purifiera les fils de Lévi et les épurera \q comme l’or et comme l’argent ; \q et ils seront {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, \q présentant une offrande dans la justice.
fr.B: Il s’assiéra comme celui qui épure et purifie l’argent ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} purifiera les descendants de Lévi et les épurera \q comme l’or et l’argent, \q pour qu’ils appartiennent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} \q et présentent des offrandes selon la justice.
fr.R: Il s’assiéra comme un ouvrier qui fait fondre l’argent pour le rendre pur. \q Il rendra purs les prêtres de la tribu de Lévi, \q comme on rend pur l’or et l’argent. \q Alors ils apporteront des offrandes {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} \q de la bonne manière.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se sentará a refinar y purificar la plata, \q y purificará a los hijos de Leví y los refinará \q como el oro y como la plata; \q y serán de {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q presentando ofrenda en justicia.
es.B: Se sentará como el que refina y purifica la plata; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} purificará a los descendientes de Leví y los refinará \q como al oro y a la plata, \q para que pertenezcan {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} \q y presenten ofrendas en justicia.
es.R: Se sentará como un obrero que funde la plata para purificarla. \q Purificará a los sacerdotes de la tribu de Leví, \q como se purifican el oro y la plata. \q Entonces ellos le traerán ofrendas {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} \q de la manera correcta.

decisions.choice: he will sit as a refiner: watching the metal closely
decisions.reason: A refiner sat by the furnace and watched the molten silver, skimming off the dross until the metal was pure. The LORD's judgment is careful and patient, aimed at a pure result. |

decisions.choice: the sons of Levi: the priests of 1:6-2:9
decisions.reason: The priests who despised the LORD's name will be purified first, so that the covenant with Levi (2:4-7) is restored and the offerings become acceptable. Judgment begins at the house of God. |

decisions.choice: in righteousness: rightly, as they should be offered
decisions.reason: The offerings will be brought in the right way, by people right with God (Psalm 4:6; 51:21). |

decisions.choice: the sons of Levi (L), the descendants of Levi (B), the priests from the tribe of Levi (R); in righteousness (L, B), in the right way (R)
decisions.reason: The sons of Levi here are the priests, who were men, so no gender setting is used. |

decisions.choice: "los hijos de Leví" (L); "los descendientes de Leví" (B); "los sacerdotes de la tribu de Leví" (R)
decisions.reason: The sons of Levi are the priests of 1:6-2:9; the levels follow the Spanish forms for "sons of" (L hijos, B descendientes) and R says who they are.

source.text: וְעָֽרְבָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה מִנְחַ֥ת יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּימֵ֣י עוֹלָ֔ם וּכְשָׁנִ֖ים קַדְמֹנִיּֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasing to Yahweh, as in [the] days of old and as in former years.

en.L: And the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q as in the days of long ago \q and as in the years of former times.
en.B: Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q as it was in days gone by, \q in years long past.
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be pleased with the offerings of the people of Judah and Jerusalem, \q as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was long ago, \q in years gone by.

fr.L: Et l’offrande de Juda et de Jérusalem sera agréable {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, \q comme aux jours d’autrefois \q et comme dans les années anciennes.
fr.B: Alors l’offrande de Juda et de Jérusalem sera agréable {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, \q comme dans les jours passés, \q dans les années d’autrefois.
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera content des offrandes des gens de Juda et de Jérusalem, \q comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’était il y a longtemps, \q dans les années passées.

es.L: Y la ofrenda de Judá y de Jerusalén será agradable {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, \q como en los días de antaño \q y como en los años antiguos.
es.B: Entonces la ofrenda de Judá y de Jerusalén será agradable {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, \q como lo fue en los días pasados, \q en años ya lejanos.
es.R: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se agradará de las ofrendas de la gente de Judá y de Jerusalén, \q como se agradaba hace mucho tiempo, \q en los años pasados.

decisions.choice: pleasing: sweet, acceptable
decisions.reason: The word is used of what is pleasant to the taste. Jeremiah 6:20 says that the people's sacrifices were not pleasing to the LORD; here they will be once more. |

decisions.choice: as in the days of old: as in the best times of Israel's past
decisions.reason: The days of old may be the time of Moses in the wilderness (Jeremiah 2:2-3) or of David and Solomon (1 Kings 8:62-64), when the people's worship was whole-hearted. |

decisions.choice: as he was long ago (R)
decisions.reason: Readable adds the comparison's verb. |

source.text: וְקָרַבְתִּ֣י אֲלֵיכֶם֮ לַמִּשְׁפָּט֒ וְהָיִ֣יתִי׀עֵ֣ד מְמַהֵ֗ר בַּֽמְכַשְּׁפִים֙ וּבַמְנָ֣אֲפִ֔ים וּבַנִּשְׁבָּעִ֖ים לַשָּׁ֑קֶר וּבְעֹשְׁקֵ֣י שְׂכַר־שָׂ֠כִיר אַלְמָנָ֨ה וְיָת֤וֹם וּמַטֵּי־גֵר֙ וְלֹ֣א יְרֵא֔וּנִי אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will draw near to you for judgment, and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers and against the adulterers and against those swearing to falsehood, and against those who oppress [the] wage of [the] hired worker, [the] widow and [the] fatherless, and who turn aside [the] sojourner, and do not fear me, says Yahweh of hosts.

en.L: And I will come near to you for judgment, \q and I will be a witness quick to act against the sorcerers, against the adulterers, \q and against those who swear to a lie, \q and against those who oppress the hired worker in wages, the widow and the fatherless, and who turn aside the sojourner, and do not fear {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts.
en.B: I will come near to you for judgment. \q I will be quick to testify against sorcerers and adulterers \q and those who swear falsely, \q against those who cheat hired workers of their wages, who oppress widows and orphans and deny justice to foreigners, and who do not fear {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.
en.R: I will come to judge you. \q I will be quick to speak against those who practice witchcraft and those who commit adultery \q and those who lie under oath. \q I will speak against those who cheat workers out of their pay and treat widows and orphans badly, and against those who refuse justice to foreigners who live among you. None of them fear {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

fr.L: Et je m’approcherai de vous pour le jugement, \q et je serai un témoin prompt contre les sorciers, contre les adultères, \q et contre ceux qui jurent pour le mensonge, \q et contre ceux qui oppriment le salarié dans son salaire, la veuve et l’orphelin, et qui écartent l’étranger, et ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} craignent pas, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.B: Je m’approcherai de vous pour le jugement. \q Je témoignerai sans tarder contre les sorciers et les adultères \q et ceux qui font de faux serments, \q contre ceux qui volent l’ouvrier de son salaire, qui oppriment la veuve et l’orphelin et privent l’immigré de justice, et qui ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} craignent pas, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.R: Je viendrai vous juger. \q Je parlerai sans tarder contre ceux qui pratiquent la sorcellerie et ceux qui commettent l’adultère, \q et ceux qui mentent sous serment. \q Je parlerai contre ceux qui volent les ouvriers en ne les payant pas, qui maltraitent les veuves et les orphelins, et contre ceux qui refusent la justice aux étrangers qui vivent parmi vous. Aucun d’eux ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} craint, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.

es.L: Y me acercaré a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} para el juicio, \q y seré testigo veloz contra los hechiceros, contra los adúlteros, \q y contra los que juran en falso, \q y contra los que defraudan en su salario al jornalero, a la viuda y al huérfano, y los que apartan al inmigrante, y no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} temen, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos.
es.B: Vendré a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} para juzgar{{plural_you:los|os}}. \q Seré un testigo rápido contra los hechiceros y los adúlteros \q y contra los que juran en falso, \q contra los que defraudan a los jornaleros en su salario, los que oprimen a las viudas y a los huérfanos y niegan la justicia a los extranjeros, y no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} temen, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.
es.R: Vendré a juzgar{{plural_you:los|os}}. \q Me apresuraré a acusar a los que practican la brujería y a los que cometen adulterio \q y a los que mienten bajo juramento. \q Acusaré a los que estafan a los trabajadores en su paga y maltratan a las viudas y a los huérfanos, y a los que niegan la justicia a los extranjeros que viven entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Ninguno de ellos {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} teme, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

decisions.choice: I will draw near to you for judgment: the answer to "Where is the God of justice?"
decisions.reason: The people asked where the God of justice was (2:17). He answers that he himself will come to judge, quickly and as a witness who has seen everything. |

decisions.choice: sorcerers, adulterers, perjurers, oppressors: sins the law condemns
decisions.reason: Each sin named breaks the law: sorcery (Exodus 22:17; Deuteronomy 18:10), adultery (Exodus 20:14), false oaths (Leviticus 19:12), withholding a worker's wages (Leviticus 19:13; Deuteronomy 24:14-15), and wronging the widow, the fatherless and the foreigner (Exodus 22:20-23; Deuteronomy 24:17; 27:19). |

decisions.choice: the fatherless, the sojourner: the orphan, and the foreigner living among the people
decisions.reason: The fatherless child and the resident foreigner had no family to defend them, so the law put them under God's special protection. "Turn aside the sojourner" means to deny him his rights (Deuteronomy 27:19). |

decisions.choice: orphans (B, R); foreigners (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the everyday words. Readable makes "do not fear me" a sentence of its own. |

decisions.choice: "huérfano"; "inmigrante" (L); "extranjeros" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The sojourner is worded as in Zechariah 7:10 and Deuteronomy 10:18 in Spanish.

source.text: כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֣א שָׁנִ֑יתִי וְאַתֶּ֥ם בְּנֵֽי־יַעֲקֹ֖ב לֹ֥א כְלִיתֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For I, Yahweh, do not change; and you, sons of Jacob, have not come to an end.

en.L: For I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, do not change; \q and you, {{gender:children|sons}} of Jacob, have not come to an end.
en.B: I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and I do not change; \q that is why you, descendants of Jacob, have not been destroyed.
en.R: I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and I never change. \q That is why you, the people of Jacob, have not been destroyed.

fr.L: Car moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je ne change pas ; \q et vous, {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Jacob, vous n’avez pas été consumés.
fr.B: Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et je ne change pas ; \q c’est pourquoi vous, descendants de Jacob, vous n’avez pas été anéantis.
fr.R: Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et je ne change jamais. \q C’est pour cela que vous, le peuple de Jacob, vous n’avez pas été détruits.

es.L: Porque yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, no cambio; \q y {{plural_you:ustedes, hijos de Jacob, no han sido consumidos|vosotros, hijos de Jacob, no habéis sido consumidos}}.
es.B: Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y no cambio; \q por eso {{plural_you:ustedes, descendientes de Jacob, no han sido destruidos|vosotros, descendientes de Jacob, no habéis sido destruidos}}.
es.R: Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y nunca cambio. \q Por eso {{plural_you:ustedes, pueblo de Jacob, no han sido destruidos|vosotros, pueblo de Jacob, no habéis sido destruidos}}.

decisions.choice: I, the LORD, do not change: the LORD is faithful to his covenant
decisions.reason: The LORD's character and his promises stay the same (Numbers 23:19; Psalm 102:28). That is why Jacob's descendants still exist, though they have turned from him again and again (verse 7). |

decisions.choice: you have not come to an end: you have not been destroyed
alternatives: you have not ceased to be what Jacob was
decisions.reason: The verb means "come to an end, be finished". Most read it as "you have not been destroyed", because the LORD is faithful. Some read it as a rebuke, "you have not stopped" being like Jacob, the deceiver, which would lead into verse 7.

decisions.choice: a new dispute begins
decisions.reason: The fourth dispute (3:6-12) concerns the people's turning away from the LORD and their withholding of tithes. |

decisions.choice: children of Jacob (L, gender default), descendants (B), people (R)
decisions.reason: The sons of Jacob are the whole people, men and women. |

decisions.choice: {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Jacob (L)
decisions.reason: The same setting as the English Literal, in the form the term sheet gives for "the sons of Israel".

decisions.choice: "hijos de Jacob"
decisions.reason: Spanish "hijos" includes daughters, so L needs no gender span, as the term sheet sets.

source.text: לְמִימֵ֨י אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֜ם סַרְתֶּ֤ם מֵֽחֻקַּי֙ וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַרְתֶּ֔ם שׁ֤וּבוּ אֵלַי֙ וְאָשׁ֣וּבָה אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בַּמֶּ֥ה נָשֽׁוּב׃

records.literal_gloss: From [the] days of your fathers you have turned aside from my statutes and have not kept [them]. Return to me, and I will return to you, says Yahweh of hosts. And you say, In what shall we return?

en.L: From the days of your fathers you have turned aside from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes and have not kept [them]. \q Turn back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I will turn back to you, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts. \q But you say, "How shall we return?"
en.B: Ever since the days of your ancestors you have strayed from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes and failed to keep them. \q Return to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I will turn to you again, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. \q Yet you ask, "In what way shall we return?"
en.R: Ever since your ancestors lived, you have turned away from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} laws and have not obeyed them. \q Come back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I will come back to you, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. \q But you ask, "How can we come back?"

fr.L: Depuis les jours de vos pères, vous vous êtes écartés de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions et ne [les] avez pas gardées. \q Revenez à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et je reviendrai à vous, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. \q Mais vous dites : « En quoi reviendrons-nous ? »
fr.B: Depuis le temps de vos ancêtres, vous vous êtes détournés de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions et vous ne les avez pas gardées. \q Revenez à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et je reviendrai à vous, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. \q Et vous demandez : « En quoi devons-nous revenir ? »
fr.R: Depuis l’époque de vos ancêtres, vous vous êtes détournés de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} lois et vous ne leur avez pas obéi. \q Revenez à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et je reviendrai à vous, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. \q Mais vous dites : « Comment pouvons-nous revenir ? »

es.L: Desde los días de {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}} {{plural_you:se han apartado|os habéis apartado}} de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos y no [los] {{plural_you:han guardado|habéis guardado}}. \q {{plural_you:Vuélvanse|Volveos}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y yo me volveré a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos. \q Pero {{plural_you:ustedes dicen|vosotros decís}}: «¿En qué hemos de volvernos?».
es.B: Desde los días de {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} {{plural_you:se han desviado|os habéis desviado}} de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos y no los {{plural_you:han cumplido|habéis cumplido}}. \q {{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y yo volveré a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. \q Pero {{plural_you:ustedes preguntan|vosotros preguntáis}}: «¿De qué manera hemos de volver?».
es.R: Desde los tiempos de {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} {{plural_you:se han alejado|os habéis alejado}} de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} leyes y no las {{plural_you:han obedecido|habéis obedecido}}. \q {{plural_you:Regresen|Regresad}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y yo regresaré a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. \q Pero {{plural_you:ustedes preguntan|vosotros preguntáis}}: «¿Cómo podemos regresar?».

decisions.choice: Return to me, and I will return to you: the call of the earlier prophets
decisions.reason: Zechariah 1:3 has the same words, and the call to return runs through the prophets (Jeremiah 3:12-14; Joel 2:12-13). "Return" means to turn back to the LORD in repentance and obedience. |

decisions.choice: "How shall we return?": the people see no need to return
decisions.reason: Their question, like the others in the book, denies the charge. The LORD answers with a specific case in verse 8. |

decisions.choice: fathers (L), ancestors (B, R); statutes (L, B), laws (R); Turn back to me (L), Return to me (B), Come back to me (R)
decisions.reason: Literal says "turn back" for both verbs, keeping the one Hebrew verb repeated. The people's question is in double quotes, as in every dispute. |

decisions.choice: shuv "revenir" at every level, for both the people and God
decisions.reason: As the term sheet, keeping the play of "Return to me, and I will return to you".

decisions.choice: chuqqim "prescriptions" (L, B), "lois" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet for statutes.

decisions.choice: "Vuélvanse a mí" (L); "Vuelvan a mí" (B); "Regresen a mí" (R)
decisions.reason: Shuv of repentance is "volver" / "volverse", as in the Spanish prophets, never "arrepentirse"; "estatutos" (L, B) and "leyes" (R) follow the term sheet for huqqim.

source.text: הֲיִקְבַּ֨ע אָדָ֜ם אֱלֹהִ֗ים כִּ֤י אַתֶּם֙ קֹבְעִ֣ים אֹתִ֔י וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בַּמֶּ֣ה קְבַעֲנ֑וּךָ הַֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֖ר וְהַתְּרוּמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Will a human rob God? For you are robbing me. And you say, In what have we robbed you? The tithe and the contribution.

en.L: Will a mortal rob God? Yet you are robbing {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q But you say, "How have we robbed {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}?" \q [In] the tithe and the contribution.
en.B: Will a mortal rob God? But you are robbing {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q Yet you ask, "In what way do we rob {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}?" \q In tithes and offerings.
en.R: Should anyone rob God? But you are robbing {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}! \q You ask, "How are we robbing {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}?" \q You rob {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} by not bringing your tithes and offerings.

fr.L: Un {{gender:mortel|homme}} volera-t-il Dieu ? Pourtant vous, vous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} volez. \q Mais vous dites : « En quoi {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons-nous volé ? » \q [Dans] la dîme et le prélèvement.
fr.B: Un {{gender:mortel|homme}} peut-il voler Dieu ? Pourtant vous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} volez. \q Et vous demandez : « En quoi {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} volons-nous ? » \q Dans les dîmes et les offrandes.
fr.R: Quelqu’un devrait-il voler Dieu ? Pourtant vous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} volez ! \q Vous dites : « Comment est-ce que nous {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} volons ? » \q Vous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} volez en n’apportant pas vos dîmes et vos offrandes.

es.L: ¿Robará el {{gender:mortal|hombre}} a Dios? Pues {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:están robando|estáis robando}}. \q Pero {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: «¿En qué {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} hemos robado?». \q [En] el diezmo y la contribución.
es.B: ¿Robará un {{gender:mortal|hombre}} a Dios? Pues {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:están robando|estáis robando}}. \q Pero {{plural_you:preguntan|preguntáis}}: «¿En qué {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} robamos?». \q En los diezmos y en las ofrendas.
es.R: ¿Acaso alguien debe robarle a Dios? ¡Pero {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:están robando|estáis robando}}! \q {{plural_you:Preguntan|Preguntáis}}: «¿Cómo {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} estamos robando?». \q Me {{plural_you:roban|robáis}} cuando no {{plural_you:traen|traéis}} {{plural_you:sus diezmos y ofrendas|vuestros diezmos y ofrendas}}.

decisions.choice: the tithe and the contribution: the gifts that supported the priests and Levites
decisions.reason: The tithe was a tenth of the harvest and the herds, given to the Levites, who gave a tenth of it to the priests (Numbers 18:21-28; Deuteronomy 14:22-29). The contribution was a portion set apart from offerings for the priests (Numbers 18:8-19). Nehemiah found the Levites gone back to their fields because the tithes were not brought (Nehemiah 13:10-12). |

decisions.choice: rob: take by force, defraud
decisions.reason: The verb is rare (Proverbs 22:23). The Greek translation is generally said to read "deceive", a verb with nearly the same letters that is the root of Jacob's name (Genesis 27:36). If that is the original reading, it links with "sons of Jacob" in verse 6.

decisions.choice: a mortal (L, B), anyone (R)
decisions.reason: The word means a human being, so the levels use words that include everyone. Literal brackets "[In]", which the Hebrew answer leaves out. |

decisions.choice: {{gender:mortel|homme}} (L, B) for ʾadam set against God
decisions.reason: As the term sheet's Micah 6:8 wording; French needs a noun here, so it carries the setting where the English "mortal" does not.

decisions.choice: mortal / hombre
decisions.reason: 'Adam set against God follows the Twelve's rule (Micah 6:8): "mortal" with "hombre" as the gender alternative.

source.text: בַּמְּאֵרָה֙ אַתֶּ֣ם נֵֽאָרִ֔ים וְאֹתִ֖י אַתֶּ֣ם קֹבְעִ֑ים הַגּ֖וֹי כֻּלּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: With the curse you are cursed, and me you are robbing, the nation, all of it.

en.L: With a curse you are cursed, \q for you are robbing {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, \q the whole nation of you.
en.B: You are under a curse, \q because you are robbing {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, \q the whole nation of you.
en.R: You are under a curse, \q because the whole nation is robbing {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

fr.L: Vous êtes maudits de la malédiction, \q car vous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} volez, \q la nation tout entière.
fr.B: Vous êtes sous le coup de la malédiction, \q parce que vous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} volez, \q la nation tout entière.
fr.R: Vous êtes sous une malédiction, \q parce que toute la nation {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} vole.

es.L: Con maldición {{plural_you:están malditos|estáis malditos}}, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:están robando|estáis robando}}, \q la nación entera.
es.B: {{plural_you:Están|Estáis}} bajo maldición, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:están robando|estáis robando}}, \q toda la nación.
es.R: {{plural_you:Están|Estáis}} bajo maldición, \q porque toda la nación {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} está robando.

decisions.choice: with a curse you are cursed: the curse of the covenant
decisions.reason: The curse is the one the covenant threatened (Deuteronomy 28:15-20), seen in the failed harvests (verses 10-11). The priests were already under it (2:2). |

decisions.choice: the whole nation: not only the priests
decisions.reason: The word for "nation" is the one used of other peoples, and Haggai 2:14 used it of Judah in rebuke. The whole people, not only its leaders, withholds what is owed. |

source.text: הָבִ֨יאוּ אֶת־כָּל־הַֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֜ר אֶל־בֵּ֣ית הָאוֹצָ֗ר וִיהִ֥י טֶ֨רֶף֙ בְּבֵיתִ֔י וּבְחָנ֤וּנִי נָא֙ בָּזֹ֔את אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אִם־לֹ֧א אֶפְתַּ֣ח לָכֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת אֲרֻבּ֣וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַהֲרִיקֹתִ֥י לָכֶ֛ם בְּרָכָ֖ה עַד־בְּלִי־דָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Bring the whole tithe into the house of the store, so that there may be food in my house, and test me, please, in this, says Yahweh of hosts, if I will not open for you the windows of the heavens and pour out for you blessing until there is no sufficiency.

en.L: Bring the whole tithe into the house of storage, so that there may be food in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house, \q and put {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to the test, please, in this, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, \q whether I will not open for you the windows of the heavens \q and pour out for you blessing until there is no more need.
en.B: Bring the full tithe into the storehouse, so that there will be food in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house. \q Put {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to the test in this, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, \q and see if I do not open the windows of heaven for you \q and pour out on you a blessing until you have more than enough.
en.R: Bring the whole tenth of your harvest into the temple storerooms, so that there will be food in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house. \q Test {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in this way, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. \q See if I do not open the windows of the sky for you \q and pour out blessings on you until you have more than you need.

fr.L: Apportez la dîme entière à la maison du trésor, pour qu’il y ait de la nourriture dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison, \q et mettez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} donc à l’épreuve en cela, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, \q [pour voir] si je n’ouvre pas pour vous les fenêtres des cieux \q et ne répands pas pour vous la bénédiction jusqu’à ce qu’il n’y ait plus de besoin.
fr.B: Apportez la dîme complète dans le trésor du temple, pour qu’il y ait de la nourriture dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison. \q Mettez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} à l’épreuve en cela, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, \q et vous verrez si je n’ouvre pas pour vous les fenêtres du ciel \q et si je ne répands pas sur vous la bénédiction en abondance, plus que vous n’en avez besoin.
fr.R: Apportez le dixième complet de vos récoltes dans les réserves du temple, pour qu’il y ait de la nourriture dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison. \q Mettez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} à l’épreuve de cette manière, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. \q Vous verrez si je n’ouvre pas pour vous les fenêtres du ciel \q et si je ne répands pas sur vous des bénédictions, plus qu’il ne vous en faut.

es.L: {{plural_you:Traigan|Traed}} el diezmo entero a la casa del almacén, para que haya alimento en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa, \q y {{plural_you:pruébenme|probadme}}, por favor, en esto, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, \q a ver si no abro para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} las ventanas de los cielos \q y derramo para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} bendición hasta que no haga falta más.
es.B: {{plural_you:Traigan|Traed}} todo el diezmo al almacén, para que haya alimento en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa. \q {{plural_you:Pónganme|Ponedme}} a prueba en esto, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, \q y {{plural_you:vean|veréis}} si no abro para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} las ventanas del cielo \q y derramo sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} una bendición tan grande que {{plural_you:les|os}} sobre.
es.R: {{plural_you:Traigan|Traed}} la décima parte completa de {{plural_you:sus cosechas|vuestras cosechas}} a los almacenes del templo, para que haya alimento en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa. \q {{plural_you:Pruébenme|Probadme}} de esta manera, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. \q {{plural_you:Verán|Veréis}} que abro para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} las ventanas del cielo \q y derramo sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} bendiciones hasta que {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} más de lo que {{plural_you:necesitan|necesitáis}}.

decisions.choice: the storehouse: the storerooms at the temple
decisions.reason: The temple had rooms where tithes of grain, wine and oil were stored for the Levites and priests (Nehemiah 10:39; 13:12-13). |

decisions.choice: test me: an invitation to prove the LORD's faithfulness
decisions.reason: The law forbids putting the LORD to the test (Deuteronomy 6:16). Here the LORD himself invites it, as a sign that he will keep his word if they keep theirs. |

decisions.choice: the windows of the heavens: the openings from which rain falls
decisions.reason: The picture is of rain pouring through openings in the sky (Genesis 7:11; 2 Kings 7:2). After drought and poor harvests, the blessing is rain and plenty. |

decisions.choice: until there is no more need: beyond what is needed
decisions.reason: The words mean "until there is not enough", that is, until the blessing is more than they can use.

decisions.choice: the whole tenth of your harvest (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what the tithe was. |

decisions.choice: "la casa del almacén" (L); "el almacén" (B); "los almacenes del templo" (R)
decisions.reason: The storehouse is the temple's storerooms. The verse was drafted from the gloss and reworded away from the wording of older Spanish Bibles.

source.text: וְגָעַרְתִּ֤י לָכֶם֙ בָּֽאֹכֵ֔ל וְלֹֽא־יַשְׁחִ֥ת לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־פְּרִ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה וְלֹא־תְשַׁכֵּ֨ל לָכֶ֤ם הַגֶּ֨פֶן֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will rebuke for you the devourer, and it will not destroy for you the fruit of the ground, and the vine in the field will not be barren for you, says Yahweh of hosts.

en.L: And I will rebuke the devourer for you, \q and it will not destroy the fruit of your ground, \q and your vine in the field will not be barren, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts.
en.B: I will rebuke the devourer for your sake, \q so that it will not destroy the crops of your land, \q and your vines in the field will not fail to bear fruit, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.
en.R: I will stop the pests that eat your crops. \q Your grapevines will not fail to produce fruit, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

fr.L: Et je menacerai pour vous le dévoreur, \q et il ne détruira pas pour vous le fruit du sol, \q et la vigne ne sera pas stérile pour vous dans les champs, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.B: Pour vous, je réprimerai le dévoreur, \q pour qu’il ne détruise pas les récoltes de votre terre, \q et vos vignes dans les champs ne manqueront pas de porter du fruit, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.R: J’arrêterai les insectes qui mangent vos récoltes. \q Vos vignes ne manqueront pas de donner des raisins, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.

es.L: Y reprenderé por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} al devorador, \q y no destruirá el fruto de {{plural_you:su tierra|vuestra tierra}}, \q ni {{plural_you:su vid|vuestra vid}} en el campo será estéril, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos.
es.B: Reprenderé por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} al devorador, \q para que no destruya las cosechas de {{plural_you:su tierra|vuestra tierra}}, \q y {{plural_you:sus viñas|vuestras viñas}} en el campo no dejarán de dar fruto, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.
es.R: Detendré las plagas que se comen {{plural_you:sus cosechas|vuestras cosechas}}. \q {{plural_you:Sus viñas|Vuestras viñas}} no dejarán de dar uvas, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

decisions.choice: the devourer: locusts or other pests that eat crops
decisions.reason: The word means "eater". It probably refers to locusts (Joel 1:4; Amos 4:9), or to any pest or blight.

decisions.choice: blessing on the harvest: the covenant blessing
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 28:4, 11 promises fruitful ground and flocks to a people who keep the covenant. |

decisions.choice: the pests that eat your crops (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what the devourer is, without naming locusts, which the text does not. |

decisions.choice: "el devorador" (L, B); "las plagas" (R)
decisions.reason: The devourer is the locust or pest that eats the crops; R says so, as the English R does.

source.text: וְאִשְּׁר֥וּ אֶתְכֶ֖ם כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֑ם כִּֽי־תִהְי֤וּ אַתֶּם֙ אֶ֣רֶץ חֵ֔פֶץ אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And all the nations will call you blessed, for you will be a land of delight, says Yahweh of hosts.

en.L: And all the nations will pronounce you blessed, \q for you yourselves will be a land of delight, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts.
en.B: Then all the nations will call you blessed, \q because you will be a delightful land, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.
en.R: Then people from all the nations will say that you are blessed, \q because your land will be a wonderful place to live, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

fr.L: Et toutes les nations vous diront heureux, \q car vous, vous serez un pays de délices, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.B: Alors toutes les nations vous diront heureux, \q car vous serez un pays où il fait bon vivre, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.R: Alors les gens de toutes les nations diront que vous êtes bénis, \q parce que votre pays sera un endroit merveilleux où vivre, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.

es.L: Y todas las naciones {{plural_you:los|os}} llamarán dichosos, \q porque {{plural_you:ustedes serán|vosotros seréis}} tierra de delicias, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos.
es.B: Entonces todas las naciones {{plural_you:los|os}} llamarán dichosos, \q porque {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} una tierra encantadora, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.
es.R: Entonces la gente de todas las naciones dirá que {{plural_you:ustedes son|vosotros sois}} dichosos, \q porque {{plural_you:su tierra|vuestra tierra}} será un lugar maravilloso para vivir, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

decisions.choice: a land of delight: a land God delights in
decisions.reason: Isaiah 62:4 promises that the land will be called "My delight is in her". Deuteronomy 33:29 calls Israel blessed among the nations. |

decisions.choice: call you blessed: count you happy and fortunate
decisions.reason: The same verb returns in verse 15, where the complainers "call the arrogant blessed". |

source.text: חָזְק֥וּ עָלַ֛י דִּבְרֵיכֶ֖ם אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם מַה־נִּדְבַּ֖רְנוּ עָלֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Your words have been strong against me, says Yahweh. And you say, What have we spoken together against you?

en.L: Your words have been hard against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q But you say, \q "What have we spoken against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}?"
en.B: You have said harsh things against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q Yet you ask, \q "What have we said against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}?"
en.R: You have said terrible things about {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q But you ask, "What have we said about {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}?"

fr.L: Vos paroles ont été dures contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Mais vous dites : \q « Qu’avons-nous dit entre nous contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ? »
fr.B: Vous avez tenu contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} des propos durs, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Et vous demandez : \q « Qu’avons-nous dit contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ? »
fr.R: Vous avez dit des choses terribles contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Mais vous dites : « Qu’est-ce que nous avons dit contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ? »

es.L: {{plural_you:Sus palabras|Vuestras palabras}} contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} han sido duras, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Pero {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: \q «¿Qué hemos hablado contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}?».
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes han dicho|Vosotros habéis dicho}} cosas duras contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Pero {{plural_you:preguntan|preguntáis}}: \q «¿Qué hemos dicho contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}?».
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes han dicho|Vosotros habéis dicho}} cosas terribles de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Pero {{plural_you:preguntan|preguntáis}}: «¿Qué hemos dicho de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}?».

decisions.choice: a new dispute: the people's complaint against God
decisions.reason: The last dispute (3:13-21) answers the people's charge that serving God is useless. The verb "spoken" means "talked among ourselves": they say these things to one another, as the faithful in verse 16 speak with one another for good. |

decisions.choice: your words have been strong against me: you have spoken harshly against me
decisions.reason: Words that are "strong" against someone are hard and defiant. |

source.text: אֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם שָׁ֖וְא עֲבֹ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֑ים וּמַה־בֶּ֗צַע כִּ֤י שָׁמַ֨רְנוּ֙ מִשְׁמַרְתּ֔וֹ וְכִ֤י הָלַ֨כְנוּ֙ קְדֹ֣רַנִּ֔ית מִפְּנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: You have said, Vain [is it] to serve God; and what profit that we have kept his charge, and that we have walked mournfully before Yahweh of hosts?

en.L: You have said, \q "Futile [is it] to serve God; \q and what profit [is there] that we have kept {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} charge, \q and that we have walked in mourning \q before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts?
en.B: You have said, "It is useless to serve God. \q What do we gain by keeping {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} requirements \q and walking around like mourners \q before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies?
en.R: You have said, "It is useless to serve God. \q What good does it do us to obey {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} \q and to go around in mourning \q before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies?

fr.L: Vous avez dit : \q « [C’est] vain de servir Dieu ; \q et quel profit [y a-t-il] à ce que nous ayons gardé ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a prescrit, \q et que nous ayons marché en deuil \q devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées ?
fr.B: Vous avez dit : « Il est inutile de servir Dieu. \q Que gagnons-nous à observer ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} demande \q et à marcher comme des gens en deuil \q devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées ?
fr.R: Vous avez dit : « Cela ne sert à rien de servir Dieu. \q À quoi bon {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} obéir \q et aller et venir en habits de deuil \q devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées ?

es.L: {{plural_you:Han dicho|Habéis dicho}}: \q «Vano [es] servir a Dios; \q ¿y qué provecho [hay] en que hayamos guardado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ordenanza, \q y en que hayamos andado de luto \q delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los ejércitos?
es.B: {{plural_you:Han dicho|Habéis dicho}}: «Es inútil servir a Dios. \q ¿Qué ganamos con cumplir {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandatos \q y con andar como enlutados \q delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos?
es.R: {{plural_you:Han dicho|Habéis dicho}}: «Es inútil servir a Dios. \q ¿De qué nos sirve obedecer{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} \q y andar de luto \q delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos?

decisions.choice: his charge: the duties he gave
decisions.reason: The word means what one is charged to keep, the LORD's requirements (Genesis 26:5; Leviticus 18:30). |

decisions.choice: walked in mourning: fasted and mourned as a sign of repentance
decisions.reason: People in mourning wore dark clothes and went about with signs of grief. The people had fasted and mourned (Zechariah 7:3-5; Isaiah 58:3) and expected God to reward it. |

decisions.choice: profit: gain
decisions.reason: The word often means gain made by greed. The people treat serving God as a business that has not paid. |

decisions.choice: the people's words in double quotes, continued into verse 15
decisions.reason: The people's words continue into verse 15, where the quotation closes. Their pronoun for God takes the deity_pronoun setting. |

decisions.choice: the people's words in « », continued into verse 15
decisions.reason: The people's complaint runs over two verses, so the « » opens here and closes at the end of verse 15, as the English does.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֕ה אֲנַ֖חְנוּ מְאַשְּׁרִ֣ים זֵדִ֑ים גַּם־נִבְנוּ֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י רִשְׁעָ֔ה גַּ֧ם בָּחֲנ֛וּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַיִּמָּלֵֽטוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And now we are calling [the] arrogant blessed; not only are those doing wickedness built up, they also test God and escape.

en.L: And now \q we call the arrogant blessed; \q not only are those who do wickedness built up, \q but they test God and escape."
en.B: So now we count the arrogant as blessed. \q Evildoers not only prosper; \q they put God to the test and get away with it."
en.R: Now we think proud people are the happy ones. \q People who do evil do well for themselves. \q They test God, and nothing happens to them."

fr.L: Et maintenant, \q nous disons heureux les arrogants ; \q non seulement ceux qui font le mal prospèrent, \q mais ils mettent Dieu à l’épreuve et échappent. »
fr.B: Alors maintenant, nous estimons heureux les arrogants. \q Non seulement ceux qui font le mal réussissent, \q mais ils mettent Dieu à l’épreuve et s’en sortent. »
fr.R: Maintenant, nous pensons que ce sont les orgueilleux qui sont heureux. \q Les gens qui font le mal réussissent bien. \q Ils provoquent Dieu, et il ne leur arrive rien. »

es.L: Y ahora \q nosotros llamamos dichosos a los soberbios; \q no solo prosperan los que hacen maldad, \q sino que tientan a Dios y escapan».
es.B: Así que ahora consideramos dichosos a los soberbios. \q Los malvados no solo prosperan, \q sino que ponen a prueba a Dios y se salen con la suya».
es.R: Ahora pensamos que los orgullosos son los felices. \q A los que hacen el mal les va bien. \q Ponen a prueba a Dios, y no les pasa nada».

decisions.choice: built up: prospering, with house and family established
decisions.reason: To be "built up" is to prosper and have a lasting family (Jeremiah 12:16; Job 22:23). |

decisions.choice: call blessed, test God: the LORD's words turned around
decisions.reason: The people take up the words of verses 10 and 12: the nations were to call Israel blessed, and the people were invited to test the LORD. Now they call the arrogant blessed and see the wicked test God without harm. |

decisions.choice: prosper (B), do well for themselves (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the picture (m1). The quotation that began in verse 14 closes here. |

decisions.choice: "prosperan"
decisions.reason: "Are built up" means prospering, with house and family established, as the meaning decision reads it; Spanish L says "prosperan", since "son edificados" would not be understood.

source.text: אָ֧ז נִדְבְּר֛וּ יִרְאֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵ֑הוּ וַיַּקְשֵׁ֤ב יְהוָה֙ וַיִּשְׁמָ֔ע וַ֠יִּכָּתֵב סֵ֣פֶר זִכָּר֤וֹן לְפָנָיו֙ לְיִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּלְחֹשְׁבֵ֖י שְׁמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Then those who feared Yahweh spoke with one another, and Yahweh paid attention and heard, and a book of remembrance was written before him for those who fear Yahweh and those who esteem his name.

en.L: Then those who feared {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to one another; \q and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} paid attention and heard, \q and a book of remembrance was written down before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q for those who feared {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and esteemed {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.
en.B: Then those who feared {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} talked with one another, \q and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} listened and heard them. \q A book of remembrance was written in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence \q about those who feared {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and honored {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.
en.R: Then the people who feared {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} talked with one another, \q and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} listened and heard what they said. \q A record was written in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence \q of those who feared {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and honored {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.

fr.L: Alors ceux qui craignaient {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} se parlèrent les uns aux autres ; \q et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fut attentif et entendit, \q et un livre de souvenir fut écrit devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} \q pour ceux qui craignaient {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et estimaient {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.
fr.B: Alors ceux qui craignaient {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} parlèrent entre eux, \q et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} écouta et entendit. \q Un livre de souvenir fut écrit en {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence \q au sujet de ceux qui craignaient {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et honoraient {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.
fr.R: Alors ceux qui craignaient {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ont parlé entre eux, \q et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a écouté et entendu ce qu’ils disaient. \q On a écrit en {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence un livre pour se souvenir \q de ceux qui craignaient {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et honoraient {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.

es.L: Entonces los que temían {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} hablaron unos con otros; \q y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} prestó atención y oyó, \q y fue escrito un libro de memoria delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} \q para los que temen {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y estiman {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.
es.B: Entonces los que temían {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} conversaron unos con otros, \q y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escuchó y los oyó. \q En {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia se escribió un libro de memoria \q acerca de los que temían {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y honraban {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.
es.R: Entonces la gente que temía {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} conversó entre sí, \q y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escuchó y oyó lo que decían. \q En {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia se escribió un registro \q de los que temían {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y honraban {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.

decisions.choice: then those who feared the LORD spoke: the faithful answer differently
decisions.reason: The verse turns from the LORD's words to what happened next. Those who feared the LORD also spoke together, but not as the complainers did, and the LORD heard them. |

decisions.choice: a book of remembrance: a record of those to be remembered
decisions.reason: Kings kept records of deeds that deserved reward (Esther 6:1-3). Scripture speaks of God's book in which his people's names are written (Exodus 32:32; Psalm 69:29; Daniel 12:1). |

decisions.choice: esteem his name: think highly of him, value him
decisions.reason: The verb means to think, consider, and so to value. They give the LORD's name the honor the priests withheld (1:6). |

decisions.choice: spoke with one another (L), talked with one another (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "each with his neighbor", which includes everyone, so the levels say "with one another". |

decisions.choice: 3:16 is narrative: passé simple at L and B, passé composé at R
decisions.reason: The one narrative verse among Malachi's disputations, as the term sheet's narrative rule.

decisions.choice: "un libro de memoria" (L, B); "un registro" (R)
decisions.reason: The book of remembrance is a record of those to be remembered; R says "registro", as the English R says "record".

source.text: וְהָ֣יוּ לִ֗י אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת לַיּ֕וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י עֹשֶׂ֣ה סְגֻלָּ֑ה וְחָמַלְתִּ֣י עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ יַחְמֹ֣ל אִ֔ישׁ עַל־בְּנ֖וֹ הָעֹבֵ֥ד אֹתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will be mine, says Yahweh of hosts, on the day when I act, a treasured possession; and I will spare them as a man spares his son who serves him.

en.L: And they will be {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, \q for the day when I act, \q a special possession; \q and I will spare them \q as a man spares his son who serves him.
en.B: They will be {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, \q {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} special treasure \q on the day when I act. \q I will spare them \q as a father spares the son who serves him.
en.R: They will belong to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. \q On the day when I act, they will be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} special treasure. \q I will have mercy on them, \q as a father has mercy on a son who serves him.

fr.L: Et ils seront à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, \q pour le jour où j’agirai, \q un trésor particulier ; \q et je les épargnerai \q comme un homme épargne son fils qui le sert.
fr.B: Ils seront à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, \q {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} trésor \q au jour où j’agirai. \q Je les épargnerai \q comme un père épargne le fils qui le sert.
fr.R: Ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartiendront, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. \q Au jour où j’agirai, ils seront {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} trésor. \q J’aurai pitié d’eux, \q comme un père a pitié d’un fils qui le sert.

es.L: Y serán {{deity_pronoun:míos|Míos}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, \q para el día en que yo actúe, \q posesión preciada; \q y los perdonaré \q como el hombre perdona a su hijo que le sirve.
es.B: Ellos serán {{deity_pronoun:míos|Míos}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, \q {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} tesoro personal \q en el día en que yo actúe. \q Los perdonaré \q como un padre perdona al hijo que le sirve.
es.R: Ellos {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenecerán, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. \q En el día en que yo actúe, serán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} tesoro personal. \q Tendré compasión de ellos, \q como un padre tiene compasión del hijo que le sirve.

decisions.choice: a special possession: the LORD's own treasure
decisions.reason: The word was used of a king's private treasure. At Sinai the LORD called Israel his special possession among all peoples (Exodus 19:5; Deuteronomy 7:6; 26:18). Here the title belongs to those who fear him. |

decisions.choice: on the day when I act, a special possession
alternatives: on the day when I make up my special possession
decisions.reason: The words can be read "on the day when I make [them] a special possession" or "on the day when I act, [they will be] a special possession". The same phrase "the day when I act" returns in verse 21, which supports the second reading.

decisions.choice: spare them as a man spares his son who serves him: show them a father's compassion
decisions.reason: The complainers said that serving God brings no profit (verse 14). The LORD answers that he will treat those who serve him as a loving father treats a son who serves him. |

decisions.choice: special possession (L), special treasure (B, R); as a man (L), a father (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word keeps the wording published at Exodus 19:5: "special possession" (L) and "special treasure" (B, R). The man is the son's father, so Balanced and Readable say "father". |

decisions.choice: segullah "un trésor particulier" (L), "mon trésor" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet and the published Exodus 19:5.

decisions.choice: "posesión preciada" (L); "tesoro personal" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The segullah reuses the Spanish of Exodus 19:5 at each level, as the English reuses its Exodus wording.

source.text: וְשַׁבְתֶּם֙ וּרְאִיתֶ֔ם בֵּ֥ין צַדִּ֖יק לְרָשָׁ֑ע בֵּ֚ין עֹבֵ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֔ים לַאֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א עֲבָדֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And you will again see [the difference] between [the] righteous and [the] wicked, between one serving God and one who has not served him.

en.L: And you will again see \q [the difference] between the righteous and the wicked, \q between one who serves God \q and one who does not serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Then once more you will see the difference \q between the righteous and the wicked, \q between the one who serves God \q and the one who does not serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Then you will see again the difference \q between people who do what is right and people who do evil, \q between those who serve God \q and those who do not.

fr.L: Et vous verrez de nouveau \q [la différence] entre le juste et le méchant, \q entre celui qui sert Dieu \q et celui qui ne {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sert pas.
fr.B: Alors vous verrez de nouveau la différence \q entre le juste et le méchant, \q entre celui qui sert Dieu \q et celui qui ne {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sert pas.
fr.R: Alors vous verrez de nouveau la différence \q entre les gens qui font ce qui est juste et ceux qui font le mal, \q entre ceux qui servent Dieu \q et ceux qui ne le servent pas.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:volverán a ver|volveréis a ver}} \q [la diferencia] entre el justo y el malvado, \q entre el que sirve a Dios \q y el que no {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sirve.
es.B: Entonces {{plural_you:verán|veréis}} otra vez la diferencia \q entre el justo y el malvado, \q entre el que sirve a Dios \q y el que no {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sirve.
es.R: Entonces {{plural_you:verán|veréis}} otra vez la diferencia \q entre los que hacen lo correcto y los que hacen el mal, \q entre los que sirven a Dios \q y los que no.

decisions.choice: you will again see: you will once more see
decisions.reason: The words are literally "you will return and see", meaning "you will see again". The complainers said that the wicked and the righteous fare alike (verse 15); the day of the LORD will show the difference. |

decisions.choice: the righteous and the wicked: those who do right before God and those who do not
decisions.reason: The pair is the one of Psalm 1:6. Here it is defined by service: those who serve God and those who do not. |

decisions.choice: people who do what is right and people who do evil (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what the two words mean. |

source.text: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֤ה הַיּוֹם֙ בָּ֔א בֹּעֵ֖ר כַּתַּנּ֑וּר וְהָי֨וּ כָל־זֵדִ֜ים וְכָל־עֹשֵׂ֤ה רִשְׁעָה֙ קַ֔שׁ וְלִהַ֨ט אֹתָ֜ם הַיּ֣וֹם הַבָּ֗א אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־יַעֲזֹ֥ב לָהֶ֖ם שֹׁ֥רֶשׁ וְעָנָֽף׃

records.literal_gloss: For look, the day is coming, burning like an oven, and all [the] arrogant and every doer of wickedness will be stubble, and the day that is coming will set them ablaze, says Yahweh of hosts, so that it will not leave them root or branch.

en.L: For look, the day is coming, \q burning like an oven, \q and all the arrogant and every doer of wickedness will be stubble; \q and the day that is coming will set them ablaze, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, \q so that it will leave them neither root nor branch.
en.B: For see, the day is coming, \q blazing like a furnace, \q when all the arrogant and all evildoers will be stubble. \q The day that is coming will set them on fire, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, \q and leave them neither root nor branch.
en.R: Look! The day is coming. \q It will burn like a hot oven. \q All the proud people and all who do evil will be like dry straw. \q On that day they will be burned up, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. \q Nothing will be left of them, not a root or a branch.

fr.L: Car voici, le jour vient, \q brûlant comme un four, \q et tous les arrogants et tous ceux qui font le mal seront du chaume ; \q et le jour qui vient les embrasera, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, \q de sorte qu’il ne leur laissera ni racine ni rameau.
fr.B: Car voici que le jour vient, \q ardent comme une fournaise, \q où tous les arrogants et tous ceux qui font le mal seront comme du chaume. \q Le jour qui vient les embrasera, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, \q et ne leur laissera ni racine ni branche.
fr.R: Regardez ! Le jour arrive. \q Il brûlera comme un four très chaud. \q Tous les orgueilleux et tous ceux qui font le mal seront comme de la paille sèche. \q Ce jour-là, ils seront brûlés, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. \q Il ne restera rien d’eux, ni racine ni branche.

es.L: Porque he aquí, viene el día, \q ardiente como un horno, \q y todos los soberbios y todos los que hacen maldad serán paja; \q y el día que viene los abrasará, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, \q de modo que no les dejará ni raíz ni rama.
es.B: Porque ya viene el día, \q ardiente como un horno, \q en que todos los soberbios y todos los malvados serán paja. \q El día que viene les prenderá fuego, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, \q y no les dejará ni raíz ni rama.
es.R: ¡Atención! Ya viene el día. \q Arderá como un horno caliente. \q Todos los orgullosos y todos los que hacen el mal serán como paja seca. \q Ese día serán quemados, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. \q No quedará nada de ellos, ni raíz ni rama.

decisions.choice: This verse is 3:19 in the Hebrew text, 4:1 in many other Bibles
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text ends the book with chapter 3, so the six verses 3:19-24 are one chapter with what goes before. Many Bibles, following the Greek and Latin, make them a fourth chapter, so their 4:1-6 is 3:19-24 here. Open Word Bible follows the numbering of the Hebrew text it translates, and Malachi is cited by the Hebrew numbers.

decisions.choice: an oven: a clay baking oven, fired very hot
decisions.reason: The oven was a clay cylinder heated with a fire inside. Stubble thrown into it burned up at once. |

decisions.choice: neither root nor branch: nothing at all left
decisions.reason: A tree with neither root nor branch is gone entirely (compare Amos 2:9). The arrogant whom the complainers called blessed (verse 15) will be burned up like stubble. |

decisions.choice: oven (L), furnace (B), hot oven (R)
decisions.reason: The word is the household baking oven; Balanced says "furnace" for its heat. Readable says "dry straw" for "stubble". |

decisions.choice: "horno" at every level
decisions.reason: The oven is a clay oven fired very hot; Spanish "horno" covers both the English "oven" and "furnace". The meaning decision's footnote gives the other numbering (4:1).

source.text: וְזָרְחָ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם יִרְאֵ֤י שְׁמִי֙ שֶׁ֣מֶשׁ צְדָקָ֔ה וּמַרְפֵּ֖א בִּכְנָפֶ֑יהָ וִֽיצָאתֶ֥ם וּפִשְׁתֶּ֖ם כְּעֶגְלֵ֥י מַרְבֵּֽק׃

records.literal_gloss: But for you who fear my name the sun of righteousness will rise, and healing [will be] in its wings; and you will go out and leap like calves of [the] stall.

en.L: But for you who fear {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name there will rise a sun of righteousness, \q and healing [will be] in its wings; \q and you will go out and frisk like calves of the stall.
en.B: But for you who revere {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, the sun of righteousness will rise, \q bringing healing in its wings. \q You will go out leaping like calves let out of the stall.
en.R: But for you who honor {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, the sun of righteousness will rise. \q Its rays will bring healing. \q You will go out and jump for joy like calves let out of their stalls.

fr.L: Mais pour vous qui craignez {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom se lèvera un soleil de justice, \q et la guérison [sera] dans ses ailes ; \q et vous sortirez et vous bondirez comme des veaux de l’étable.
fr.B: Mais pour vous qui révérez {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, le soleil de justice se lèvera, \q portant la guérison dans ses ailes. \q Vous sortirez en bondissant comme des veaux qu’on lâche de l’étable.
fr.R: Mais pour vous qui honorez {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, le soleil de justice se lèvera. \q Ses rayons apporteront la guérison. \q Vous sortirez en sautant de joie, comme des veaux qu’on fait sortir de l’étable.

es.L: Pero para {{plural_you:ustedes, los que temen|vosotros, los que teméis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, nacerá un sol de justicia, \q y en sus alas [habrá] sanidad; \q y {{plural_you:saldrán y saltarán|saldréis y saltaréis}} como becerros del establo.
es.B: Pero para {{plural_you:ustedes, los que reverencian|vosotros, los que reverenciáis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, saldrá el sol de justicia \q trayendo sanidad en sus alas. \q {{plural_you:Saldrán|Saldréis}} brincando como becerros sueltos del establo.
es.R: Pero para {{plural_you:ustedes, los que honran|vosotros, los que honráis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, saldrá el sol de justicia. \q Sus rayos traerán sanidad. \q {{plural_you:Saldrán y saltarán|Saldréis y saltaréis}} de alegría como becerros que salen del establo.

decisions.choice: the sun of righteousness: righteousness rising like the sun
decisions.reason: The LORD's righteousness, his putting things right and vindicating his people, will dawn on them like the sun (Isaiah 58:8; 60:1-3; Psalm 37:6). The day that burns the arrogant (verse 19) brings light and healing to those who fear him. |

decisions.choice: healing in its wings: healing carried by its rays
decisions.reason: The sun's rays are pictured as wings spreading over the earth (compare Psalm 139:9, "the wings of the dawn"). In the ancient Near East the sun was often shown as a disk with wings. |

decisions.choice: the sun of righteousness and later Christian reading
decisions.reason: Christians have long applied the phrase to Christ, linking it with "the dawn from on high" in Luke 1:78. The text speaks of the coming of the LORD's righteousness. The phrase is lowercase as a picture, not a title. |

decisions.choice: calves of the stall: young cattle released from the stall
decisions.reason: Calves kept in a stall to be fattened leap and run when let out into the open. |

decisions.choice: the sun of righteousness at every level, lowercase
decisions.reason: The phrase is kept at every level ("a sun of righteousness" at Literal, which has no article, as the Hebrew), because readers know it and the picture is the point; Readable explains the wings as rays. |

decisions.choice: "le soleil de justice", lowercase, at every level; "la guérison dans ses ailes" (L, B), "Ses rayons apporteront la guérison" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet; no deity_pronoun span on "ses", which refers to the sun.

decisions.choice: "un sol de justicia" (L); "el sol de justicia" (B, R), lowercase
decisions.reason: The wording follows the term sheet at each level and keeps "sol" lowercase, as the English does; the meaning decision gives the later Christian reading.

source.text: וְעַסּוֹתֶ֣ם רְשָׁעִ֔ים כִּֽי־יִהְי֣וּ אֵ֔פֶר תַּ֖חַת כַּפּ֣וֹת רַגְלֵיכֶ֑ם בַּיּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲנִ֣י עֹשֶׂ֔ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And you will tread down [the] wicked, for they will be ashes under [the] soles of your feet, on the day when I act, says Yahweh of hosts.

en.L: And you will tread down the wicked, \q for they will become ashes \q under the soles of your feet, \q on the day when I act, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts.
en.B: You will trample on the wicked; \q they will be ashes \q beneath your feet \q on the day when I act, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.
en.R: You will walk over the wicked as if they were ashes \q under your feet. \q This will happen on the day when I act, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

fr.L: Et vous foulerez les méchants, \q car ils seront de la cendre \q sous la plante de vos pieds, \q au jour où j’agirai, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.B: Vous piétinerez les méchants ; \q ils seront comme de la cendre \q sous vos pieds \q au jour où j’agirai, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.R: Vous marcherez sur les méchants comme sur de la cendre \q sous vos pieds. \q Cela arrivera au jour où j’agirai, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:pisotearán|pisotearéis}} a los malvados, \q porque ellos serán ceniza \q bajo las plantas de {{plural_you:sus pies|vuestros pies}}, \q en el día en que yo actúe, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos.
es.B: {{plural_you:Pisotearán|Pisotearéis}} a los malvados; \q serán ceniza \q bajo {{plural_you:sus pies|vuestros pies}} \q en el día en que yo actúe, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.
es.R: {{plural_you:Caminarán|Caminaréis}} sobre los malvados como si fueran ceniza \q bajo {{plural_you:sus pies|vuestros pies}}. \q Esto sucederá en el día en que yo actúe, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

decisions.choice: ashes: the remains of the burning of verse 19
decisions.reason: The wicked burned like stubble on the day of verse 19 are left as ashes, and the righteous walk over them. |

decisions.choice: on the day when I act: the day of verse 17
decisions.reason: The same phrase is used in verse 17. |

source.text: זִכְר֕וּ תּוֹרַ֖ת מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדִּ֑י אֲשֶׁר֩ צִוִּ֨יתִי אוֹת֤וֹ בְחֹרֵב֙ עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל חֻקִּ֖ים וּמִשְׁפָּטִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Remember [the] instruction of Moses my servant, which I commanded him at Horeb for all Israel, statutes and judgments.

en.L: Remember the law of Moses {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant, \q which I commanded him at Horeb for all Israel, \q statutes and judgments.
en.B: Remember the law of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant Moses, \q the statutes and rulings I commanded him at Horeb for all Israel.
en.R: Remember the law of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant Moses. \q I gave him those laws and rules at Mount Horeb for all the people of Israel.

fr.L: Souvenez-vous de la Loi de Moïse, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, \q que je lui ai prescrite à Horeb pour tout Israël : \q prescriptions et jugements.
fr.B: Souvenez-vous de la Loi de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur Moïse, \q des prescriptions et des ordonnances que je lui ai données à Horeb pour tout Israël.
fr.R: Souvenez-vous de la Loi de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur Moïse. \q Je lui ai donné ces lois et ces règles sur le mont Horeb pour tout le peuple d’Israël.

es.L: {{plural_you:Acuérdense|Acordaos}} de la ley de Moisés, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo, \q que le ordené en Horeb para todo Israel, \q estatutos y decretos.
es.B: {{plural_you:Acuérdense|Acordaos}} de la ley de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo Moisés, \q de los estatutos y normas que le ordené en Horeb para todo Israel.
es.R: {{plural_you:Recuerden|Recordad}} la ley de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo Moisés. \q En el monte Horeb le di esas leyes y normas para todo el pueblo de Israel.

decisions.choice: Horeb: the mountain of God, also called Sinai
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy calls the mountain where the LORD gave the law Horeb (Deuteronomy 4:10; 5:2). |

decisions.choice: remember the law of Moses: the close of the book, and of the Prophets
decisions.reason: The last words of Malachi point back to the law of Moses and forward to the coming of Elijah (verses 23-24). In the Hebrew Bible Malachi closes the Prophets, and these verses join the law and the prophets together. |

decisions.choice: the law of Moses at every level; my servant (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: "The law of Moses" follows Ezra 3:2 for this phrase; elsewhere in the prophets torah is "instruction". "My servant" is kept at every level for the LORD's title for Moses, as the prophets' "my servant" is published (Jeremiah 7:25; 33:21); 2 Kings 21:8 has "slave" at Literal. |
